title.purpose: App header only. One instance per page.

body.purpose: Message content, source panel prose, example buttons. The reading voice.

label.purpose: Panel headers, ghost button text, section titles in source prose.

meta.purpose: Rerank scores, section path breadcrumbs, kind annotations. High-density layer.

mono.purpose: Calibration document IDs and file stems. Bold for scan-ability in tight badge contexts.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Applied at rest on header, message bubbles, and source cards. Structural layer separation.

shadows.name: interactive-lift
shadows.purpose: Source cards on hover only. Communicates interactivity. Resets to ambient-low on mouse-leave.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: State transitions: button hover, input focus, card hover.

motion.name: duration-typing
motion.purpose: Typing indicator dot cycle (infinite, staggered 200ms per dot).

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Below this width, DocPanel collapses or hides.

narrative.overview:
This is a metrologist's workstation, not a chat product. The Calibration Bench means a technician's workspace where every element occupies a known position, serves a measurement function, and nothing decorates for its own sake. A user arrives with an instrument, a procedure number, and a question — the interface must disappear into that task the moment they start typing.

The visual system is restrained by discipline, not laziness. Slate neutrals hold the field. Instrument Blue appears exactly where it belongs — on primary actions, focus states, and navigational anchors — and nowhere else. Formulas are first-class content: rendered with precision, visually distinguished by a full container border (never a side stripe), and never recomputed or approximated downstream.

This system rejects three wrong registers: the Vietnamese government-portal aesthetic (colored section headers, red/gold/green palette, small crowded type), generic chat-clone minimalism (centered bubble UI, consumer curves), and enterprise-dashboard weight (navy-grey walls, data tables without hierarchy).
keyCharacteristics: System font throughout — no custom typefaces competing with technical content
Two surface levels exactly (page bg, elevated panel/card) — no deeper layering
Instrument Blue on 10% or less of visible surface at any time — action and state only, never fill
Formulas distinguished by full four-side border + background tint — never by a left-side stripe
Monospace for calibration IDs and file stems — code-legibility is functional, not decorative
Flat at rest; minimal lift on hover — the interface recedes

rules.name: The One Instrument Rule
rules.body: Instrument Blue is the only non-neutral, non-semantic color permitted. It appears on 10% or less of visible surface at any time. A second accent anywhere is a violation.

rules.name: The Semantic Confinement Rule
rules.body: Error Red, Success Green, and Warning Amber appear only when conveying their explicit semantic state. Using red for navigational labels or green for decorative badges is prohibited.

rules.name: The Scale Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing below 10px. Every new metadata annotation starts at 11px (Meta role).

rules.name: The Monospace Discipline Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for calibration document identifiers, file stems, and inline code only.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Every surface ships at Ambient Low or flat. Interactive Lift appears only in direct response to user hover or focus.

dos: Do use Instrument Blue (#2563EB) exclusively on primary interactive elements.
Do give formula blocks a full four-side border (border: 1px solid #E2E8F0). Never a border-left stripe.
Do set placeholder and hint text to Ink Tertiary (#64748B) or darker for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.
Do keep section path text at Ink Tertiary (#64748B) — navigational breadcrumb, not error state.
Do apply prefers-reduced-motion overrides for all animations.
Do use Monospace role for all calibration document identifiers and file stems.
Do keep shadows at Ambient Low at rest; Interactive Lift applies on hover/focus only.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent on any element. The current border-left: 3px on .katex-display is a violation to fix.
Don't use text-red-500 or any error-state color for non-error content. Fix SourceCard section path to Ink Tertiary.
Don't use Ink Muted (#94A3B8) for any text that must be read — fails WCAG AA on Lab White.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient).
Don't use Instrument Blue as a background fill for panels or containers.
Don't introduce a second accent color anywhere in the interface.
Don't make this look like a Vietnamese government portal: no colored headers, no red/gold/green palette.
Don't make this look like a generic consumer chat clone.
Don't use numbered section markers or tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows as new-screen scaffold.
